title: 건널목 개량촉진법 시행령 / queue:ARTICLE:6:0:00006:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 6 (Establishment of Railroad Crossing Improvement Plan, etc.)
(1) A railroad facility manager and a road management authority shall establish a plan for grade separation or structural improvement of a railroad crossing pursuant to the former part of Article 5 (1) of the Act (hereinafter referred to as a "railroad crossing improvement plan") within two years from the date on which they are notified of designation of the railroad crossing for improvement pursuant to Article 4 (2) of the Act.
(2) Where a railroad facility manager and a road management authority establish a railroad crossing improvement plan pursuant to paragraph (1) and improve the railroad crossing, construction may be implemented annually within budgetary limits.
